name: Assamite Sorcery (Awakening of the Steel) — Basic — Confer with the Blade

system.description: You delve into the history and present condition of an edged weapon you wield. Make a Static Mental Challenge, risking up to five Mental Traits, against a difficulty of 7 Traits. If you win, the number of Traits risked determines the depth of information gained: 1 Trait reveals physical information (length, weight, composition, damage dice and type); 2 Traits reveal the blade's forging history and the smith's name and face; 3 Traits reveal the type and level of any enchantments and their creator's name and face (and lowers the difficulty of your next ritual applied to the weapon by one); 4 Traits grant comprehensive knowledge of the sword's history and let you recognize the taste of any blood that has ever stained the blade for the next seven nights; 5 Traits create total communion between sword and wielder, revealing any event in the blade's history or aspect of its condition at the Storyteller's discretion. You must have a total number of Ability Traits in Melee and Crafts: Blacksmith equal to your level of mastery in this path.
system.duration: Instant (or 7 nights for the taste-recognition effect)
